Roast Eye Of Round
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:45pm

Ingredients




4 lbs. eye roast
1 lg. onion
1 env. "Au Jus" gravy mix
1/4 cup dry vermouth mixed with ¼ c. water
1 roasting bag

Preparation

1 Combine gravy mix and vermouth and pour over roast after inserting into roasting bag. Slice onions and place on top of roast. Seal bag and pierce for air vents according to package directions, using shallow 2 inch deep roasting pan. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 1/2 hours. Test for doneness before removing from bag. If tender, remove according to directions. Make gravy if desired.
